InstaEclipse already keeps the photos and videos of a chat as Instagram shows them. This also reads the few items Instagram keeps on this device for this chat. View-once and replayable media are kept only after you open them in Instagram, or when they are yours.

Reads the few media items Instagram keeps on this device for every chat of this account. Instagram 454 does not keep the chat history on the device: media are kept as you open and scroll your chats. View-once and replayable media are kept only after you open them, or when they are yours.
